title: Mara and the Tide
author: Tamsin Thackeray
blurb: Edmund Blackwood, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
